---
title: "3 · Describing data"
subtitle: "Distributions, summaries, correlation"
---

Before fitting anything, look at the data. This topic covers summarising and
plotting numerical and categorical variables, and measuring how two variables
move together — along with the ways correlation can mislead you.

| 🖥 [Correlation](/slides/20-data-description/correlation.html) | Correlation types, interpreting strength, and where correlation misleads |
